'''Chris Wooten''' was a finalist at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]]. Wooten qualified through Yavin IV Richmond from Franklin, Tennessee, United States.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
